description: List Mint's versioned curated humanoid animation sets for common coding-agent and game-development needs. Each result has a stable set ID, semantic clip roles, exact action IDs, descriptions, tags, preview GIFs, and companion-asset assembly metadata. Call this before choosing a common bundle such as basic locomotion, combat, seated NPC, prop interaction, or social behavior, then pass the returned ID as animation_set_id to animate_generated_model. This read-only tool does not start animation.

query.description: Optional behavior, role, or companion-asset query such as locomotion, rifle, seated, or door.

name: list_model_animation_sets
title: List Model Animation Sets
